'built again' divides between the two verbs the Hebrew writes — shuv supplies 'again' and banah 'he built' — so only one connective is written and the second waw is unrepresented; giving the connective to the second waw instead is the competing reading.
'all the host of heaven' renders the rectum anarthrously, so the rectum's article takes the fronted 'the' under rule 29 while the construct keeps only its own word.
The lamed before kol tzeva ha-shamayim is unrepresented under rule 40, the ASV promoting its object to a bare direct object of 'worshipped'.
